source.section: Schedule SB (PDF page 1) and its Instructions: line 5 (SB Instructions PDF page 2; 30% long-term gain exclusion); Form 1 lines 1-12 (Form 1 PDF page 1); Form 1 Instructions PDF page 15 line 8 and lines 10a-10b (PDF pages 15-16), PDF pages 35-37 2025 Standard Deduction Table (row named in worked), PDF page 15 line 12 with the PDF pages 38-43 Tax Table and PDF page 44 Tax Computation Worksheet; tax figured from the 2025 Tax Rate Schedules, Publication 106 PDF pages 6-7

worked: Single, 60: wages 40,000 and long-term capital gains 20,000 (no losses, no carryover). Schedule SB line 5 (from Schedule WD) subtracts 30% of the long-term gain; the standard deduction is then looked up on the lower Wisconsin income. Federal (given, not tested): federal AGI = wages (you) 40,000.00 + long term gains 20,000.00 = 60,000.00. Federal taxable income = 60,000.00 - standard deduction 15,750.00 = 44,250.00; the federal senior deduction is ignored. Form 1 line 1 federal AGI 60,000.00; line 2 Schedule I adjustments 0.00; line 3 60,000.00; line 4 additions 0.00; line 5 60,000.00. Schedule SB: line 5 capital gain subtraction, 30% x 20,000.00 long-term gain = 6,000.00; line 50 total 6,000.00. Form 1 line 6 6,000.00; line 7 Wisconsin income = 60,000.00 - 6,000.00 = 54,000.00. Line 8 standard deduction, 2025 Standard Deduction Table (Form 1 Instructions PDF page 35), row 54,000 to less than 54,500, column Single: 9,396.00 (printed row, at least / less than / single / joint / separate / head of household: 54,000 / 54,500 / 9,396 / 19,960 / 3,849 / 9,707). Line 9 = 54,000.00 - 9,396.00 = 44,604.00. Line 10a 1 x 700 = 700.00; line 10b 0 x 250 = 0.00; line 10c 700.00. Line 11 taxable income = 44,604.00 - 700.00 = 43,904.00. Line 12 tax, Schedule A (single) as numbers: 3.5% x 14,680.00 = 513.80 + 4.4% x 29,224.00 = 1,285.856; total 1,799.656, rounded once to 1,799.66. The Tax Table row 43,900 to 44,000 (PDF page 40) gives 1,802; expected keeps the schedule. Credits (lines 13-20, 30-35): none modelled; 0.00. State income tax 1,799.66.
